description: This Java class defines a NotificationsSubscription that manages notification subscriptions, including filtering by notification type, maintaining unread notifications, and creating updates for notification counts and lists.

classes.name: NotificationsSubscription
classes.description: Manages notification subscriptions, filtering by notification type, maintaining unread notifications, and generating updates.

methods.name: checkNotificationType
methods.description: Checks if a notification type is included in the subscription's filter.

methods.name: createFullUpdate
methods.description: Creates a full update containing all sorted unread notifications.

methods.name: getSortedNotifications
methods.description: Returns unread notifications sorted by creation time in descending order.

methods.name: createPartialUpdate
methods.description: Creates an update for a single notification.

methods.name: createCountUpdate
methods.description: Creates an update with the total unread notification count.
